market_context: The S&P 500 fell 3.7% on Friday to 6910 and lost 8.6% on the week, its worst since April 2025. The Nasdaq had its worst week since March 2020, and the VIX topped 40. Futures are sharply higher this morning: S&P up about 2.5%, Nasdaq-100 up about 3%+, Dow up about 2%. Nvidia is up 8-9% pre-market after Trump backed Jensen Huang's return and Bessent softened his tone on China chip sales. Asian authorities also announced market-support measures, and the VIX has dropped from about 40 to about 30. The risk is a fade, since strategists warn that rebounds like this often don't hold. PCE inflation data is due Wednesday, and the 10-year yield is high at 4.92%.

predictions.reasoning: S&P futures are up about 2.5-2.8% pre-market, which puts SPY near 707-709 against the $689.81 baseline. Some of the gap may fade, but the oversold bounce, the lower VIX and the policy support should keep it well above Friday's close.
Nasdaq-100 futures are up 3-3.6% as semiconductors and AI names rebound after the worst week since 2020. A partial fade from the pre-market high still leaves QQQ well above $608.45.

Nvidia is up 8-9.7% pre-market after Trump publicly urged the board to reinstate Huang and Bessent drew a line between selling chips to China and supplying its military. It closed Friday at a 52-week low after falling 14%. An SEC probe and the leadership turmoil could cap the bounce, so I target a gain of about 6%.
Dow futures are up about 1.9-2%, roughly 950 points, which points to about 490 for DIA against the $481.08 baseline. I assume some of the gap fades, so my target is about 1.4% higher.
META fell 5.9% on Friday and 12.6% over five days, so it is oversold. Mega-cap tech is rebounding with the Nasdaq-100 futures up more than 3%, and META has high beta to that move.
